shortDescription: Create, archive, modify, and delete FreeIPA/IdM vaults

options.name: data
options.description: Secret payload to archive. Required when C(state=archived) and C(data_file) is not set. Mutually exclusive with C(data_file).

options.name: data_file
options.description: Path to a file whose contents will be archived as the secret payload. Mutually exclusive with C(data).

options.name: description
options.description: Human-readable description for the vault.

options.name: ipaadmin_password
options.description: Password for the principal. Used to obtain a Kerberos ticket via C(kinit). Not required if C(kerberos_keytab) is set or a valid ticket already exists.

options.name: ipaadmin_principal
options.description: Kerberos principal to authenticate as.

options.name: kerberos_keytab
options.description: Path to a Kerberos keytab file. Takes precedence over C(ipaadmin_password). Required for non-interactive use in AAP Execution Environments.

options.name: members
options.description: List of users, groups, or service principals to ensure are vault members. Delta-only — only adds members not already present.

options.name: members_absent
options.description: List of users, groups, or service principals to ensure are not vault members. Delta-only — only removes members currently present.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the vault.

options.name: server
options.description: FQDN of the IPA server.

options.name: service
options.description: Service vault scope — the vault is owned by this service principal. Mutually exclusive with C(username) and C(shared).

options.name: shared
options.description: Shared vault scope. Mutually exclusive with C(username) and C(service).

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) ensures the vault exists. Creates it if absent; updates C(description) or C(vault_type) if changed. C(absent) removes the vault. A no-op if the vault does not exist. C(archived) ensures the vault exists and then stores the payload in it. For standard vaults, the current payload is retrieved and compared; the archive step is skipped when the payload is identical. For symmetric and asymmetric vaults, the payload is always archived because comparison would require re-encryption.

options.name: username
options.description: User vault scope — the vault is owned by this user. Mutually exclusive with C(service) and C(shared).

options.name: vault_password
options.description: Password for a symmetric vault. Required when creating or archiving a C(vault_type=symmetric) vault. Mutually exclusive with C(vault_password_file).

options.name: vault_password_file
options.description: Path to a file containing the symmetric vault password. Mutually exclusive with C(vault_password).

options.name: vault_public_key
options.description: RSA public key (PEM format) for an asymmetric vault. Required when C(vault_type=asymmetric) and the vault is being created. Mutually exclusive with C(vault_public_key_file).

options.name: vault_public_key_file
options.description: Path to a file containing the RSA public key (PEM format) for an asymmetric vault. Mutually exclusive with C(vault_public_key).

options.name: vault_type
options.description: Vault encryption type. Used when creating the vault and validated when the vault already exists. The module fails if the existing vault type does not match this value because changing vault type in place is not supported.

options.name: verify
options.description: Path to the IPA CA certificate for TLS verification. Auto-detected from C(/etc/ipa/ca.crt) when not set. If neither is available, the module fails unless C(verify) is set to C(false) explicitly.
